question: Does one support-first recentering law admit bounded nonascending, headroom-preserving and nonpenetration-worsening joint targets on all exposed R10AP raising inputs, before another physical controller is selected?

population.selection: Every nonterminal observation in original order; include the terminal sample in contact diagnosis.

algorithm.candidates: Original 90 V28 torso candidates, anchors and free-foot placement; original speeds, joint limits and 0.02-rad progressive headroom rule.
algorithm.support_gap: Horizontal distance of measured-offset COM under proposed rigid body pose to convex hull of all four proposed cap centers. This optimistic geometric hull is not measured support or force authority.
algorithm.outside_rule: If initial gap exceeds 1e-12 m, reject upward translation and require strict gap decrease exceeding 1e-12 m. Rank by gap, maximum headroom deficit, total deficit, then original partial-support standing-height cost, each with original lexicographic epsilon 1e-12.
algorithm.inside_rule: Inside the all-cap hull, retain original V28 deficit and cost ranking; retain the new body-floor guard.
algorithm.floor_guard: On this declared horizontal native floor y=0 only, compute ideal rigid FK bottoms for compiled torso box and eight capsules. Each proposed bottom must be at least min(0, its original bottom) minus 1e-12 m. Existing penetration is not normalized; no currently clear body may penetrate. This is an endpoint geometric constraint, not a swept-collision or callback-contact guarantee.
algorithm.refusal: Retain explicit counts and reasons through geometric, headroom, nonascending, floor, support-progress and improving-rank admission; no physical fallback is selected.

checks: Run known-answer hull, translation, deficit, ranking, shape-bottom and floor-guard controls before retained-input evaluation.
Reconstruct every original V28 plan and refusal against retained native receipts before evaluating the distinct law.
Verify independent FK, anchor residual <=0.0005 m, original speed/joint bounds and free-foot nonascending displacement <=0.1*dt.
Independently replay the partial-recovery contact frames and retain all-cap, actual-foot and all-body contact envelopes plus nonfoot normal-impulse share.
Retain all rows and refusals; do not tune objective priorities or bounds after results.
limitations: One-step geometry only. No propagated model, force or torque feasibility, collision-free path, contact acquisition, body-motion prediction, controller selection, source-key renewal, new physical population, cap change or deadline change.
